verdict.rationale: A probe confirms docs.letta.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-oriented summary content, directly supporting the ability to point an agent at Letta's llms.txt; the docs also expose a broad set of agent-oriented documentation pages (CLI, SDK, memory, self-hosting) that such a file indexes.
